questionText:
Trace the state of an initially empty stack S following these consecutive operations: Push(10), Push(20), Pop(), Push(30), Push(40), Pop():
(A) After Push(10), Push(20): Stack contents are [10, 20] with top pointing to 20
(B) After Pop(): 20 is removed; Stack contents are [10] with top pointing to 10
(C) After Push(30), Push(40): Stack contents are [10, 30, 40] with top pointing to 40
(D) After final Pop(): 40 is removed; Stack final state is [10, 30] with top pointing to 30

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Following LIFO rules: [10, 20] -> pop removes 20 -> [10] -> pushes 30, 40 -> [10, 30, 40] -> pop removes 40 -> [10, 30].
Hence, Option D is correct.
Hence, option (D) is correct.

detailedSolution:
